title: Analysis of Endoloops, Endostaples and Endoclips for Closing the Appendiceal Stump During Laparoscopic Appendectomy
brief_summary: In this randomized control trial the patients with acute appendicitis will be divided in three groups according to the management of the appendiceal stump(Endostapler, Endoloop or Endoclip). Pre-, peri- and postoperative data will be analysed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with clinically and radiologically(Ultrasound) verified appendicitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients converted from laparoscopy to open surgery
